# Ina Qvist

Ina Qvist is a clinical specialist nurse (sygeplejerske) with a doctoral degree (ph.d.) who serves on the steering committee of AFDK, the Danish national quality database for atrial fibrillation [^src1]. She is affiliated with [[aarhus-universitetshospital|Aarhus Universitetshospital]] [^src1][^src2].

Her listed credentials — sygeplejerske, cand.scient.san., ph.d. — indicate a career path from clinical nursing into academic research, reflecting the kind of specialist expertise the AFDK steering committee draws on to oversee data quality and clinical governance for atrial fibrillation care in Denmark [^src1]. She appears in the AFDK annual report covering the period 1 July 2022 to 30 June 2023, in the chapters describing the database's data foundation, patient population definitions, data collection limitations, and the composition of the steering group itself.

Beyond her name, title, and hospital affiliation, the source material provides no further biographical or professional detail about Ina Qvist. No claims or timeline events involving her are recorded in the corpus.
